item.title: Scheduled Unity Version Control Maintenance
item.description:
Scheduled maintenance - Collaboration / Unity DevOps, Unity Version Control, Europe node, North America node, East Asia node, North East Asia node

November 9, 2026 · 12:29 UTC
Scheduled

We’re always working to make our service faster, more reliable, and better suited to your needs. As part of that commitment, we’ll be carrying out a scheduled maintenance window on Sunday, November 15th, to make important infrastructure improvements.

What to expect

To keep disruption to a minimum, maintenance will be performed region by region rather than all at once. When maintenance begins in a given region, services there may be temporarily unavailable for approximately 15 to 30 minutes, after which they will resume as normal. Regions not undergoing maintenance at that moment will continue to operate without interruption.

Do I need to take any action?

No action is required on your part. We recommend planning any critical tasks outside the maintenance window where possible.

These improvements are an investment in the quality and stability of the service you rely on, and we’re excited about the benefits they’ll bring. We appreciate your patience and understanding while we complete this work.

Thank you for being with us.
